items.title: MongoDB Mastra Integration Adds Hybrid Search, Auto Embedding, and Reranking
items.summary: Builders use Mastra, an open-source TypeScript framework, to create increasingly capable agents with MongoDB. But preparing retrieval for those agents can mean copying operational data into a separate collection, generating and syncing embeddings, merging semantic and keyword results, reranking, and fetching full records: a lot of code to maintain, and a lot of places for data to drift.
